manuscript.label: thm:nocanonical
manuscript.counting_scope: Theorem 6.1(3): exactly 2^c reconstructions for an integrable field with c certified connected components.
manuscript.pinning_scope: Refinement of Theorem 6.1(3): arbitrary finite vertex pin lists, with exactly 2^u solutions when jointly consistent, where u counts actual components containing no pinned vertex; otherwise zero. Not a new manuscript theorem or the rank formulas.
manuscript.traversal_scope: Algorithmic refinement of Theorem 6.1: executable reconstruction from supplied actual component-root walks, with universal soundness/completeness and agreement on existence with the exhaustive reference. No automatic forest construction or rank formulas.
manuscript.automatic_scope: Algorithmic refinement of Theorem 6.1: automatically construct actual component indices and rooted walks from a finite decidable graph; sound/complete reconstruction for arbitrary binary edge fields and pins, without caller-supplied traversals. No sparse spanning-forest or rank formulas.
manuscript.rank_scope: Cardinality form of Theorem 6.1(4): actual derivative image has 2^(n-c) elements and the actual additive quotient has 2^(m+c-n) elements. Cardinality ranks are log2 of these complete duplicate-free lists; no external vector-space basis library is used.

changes: Move import Std before the module documentation.
Add explicit pointwise change goals in invariant_complement, invariant_xor and invariant_and; keep every original theorem statement.
Add the two-world additive and Boolean retraction obstruction and explicit witnesses for omitted hypotheses.

Formalize simple-cycle integrability, kernel characterization, component parameterization and root-fixed uniqueness; add an executable finite solver with universal soundness/completeness and concrete controls.
Prove duplicate-free complete enumeration and the exact 2^c reconstruction count using a certified component index; add executable counts and assumption controls.
Prove complete duplicate-free partial-pin reconstruction counts; count actual components containing no pin, and retain arbitrary repeated and conflicting pin constraints.

Add a solver that selects component root values from arbitrary pins, integrates supplied checked walks, and checks one candidate against all edges and pins; prove soundness, completeness and the exact reference-comparison contract.

Add an indexed dependent array cache, bounded all-pairs path construction with universal completeness, actual finite component indexing, and automatic reconstruction with the reference solver correctness contract.
Index each actual undirected edge once; prove equal derivative fibers, the additive quotient and its equal cosets, exact image and quotient cardinalities, and their binary cardinality rank formulas.
component_count_definition: Length of a complete duplicate-free list of actual connected-component quotient classes. A canonical component index is constructed for every Fin n graph.
unpinned_component_count_definition: Length of a complete duplicate-free list of actual component quotient classes containing no vertex in the supplied pin list.
automatic_traversal_contract: n tabulated path-extension rounds cover every reachable pair by simple-walk reduction. Array size and dependent entry indices are checked. Representatives and component indices are computed from actual stored walks.
